contentList.content: Hardened by the concrete jungles of San Francisco and Los Angeles, the Homeless Californian channels makeshift biological warfare, erratic street fury, and the gravity-defying equilibrium of the legendary Fent Lean.
Master of chemical concoctions and sidewalk biohazards. Amplifies the potency of toxic clouds and explosive biological payloads, until every strike drips with poison.
A ferocious close-quarters pugilist specializing in improvised shivs, reckless flurries, and chaotic shopping cart charges.
An erratic street phantom who slips through turnstiles and spatial dimensions, never quite where the enemy expects.

Hurl a handful of raw biological waste at a target. On a hit, deals 1d10 + Constitution Bludgeoning (2d10 at level 5, 3d10 at level 10) and 1d6 Poison damage, leaves a puddle of filth, and inflicts Fecal Stench for 2 turns. Can be used as often as you like.

Hurl a dense, fermented payload with devastating force. On a hit, deals an extra 1d10 Bludgeoning on top of Sling Poop (3d10 + Constitution at level 5, 4d10 at level 10) and 2d6 Poison damage, leaves a wider puddle of filth, and inflicts Fecal Stench for 3 turns. Can be used as often as you like.
Flick a concentrated dose at an enemy. Deals 2d6 Psychic damage. On a failed Constitution saving throw the target falls into Fent Stupor for 2 turns. Recharges on a Short Rest.

Scatter an entire contraband brick across a 4m area. Every creature caught takes 5d6 Psychic damage and must make a Constitution saving throw or fall into Fent Stupor until the end of its next turn; on a success, half damage. Recharges on a Short Rest.

Fold forward at a perfect, gravity-defying 90-degree angle as a Bonus Action. For 3 turns you have Resistance to all damage, +3 Armour Class, Advantage on Constitution and Dexterity saving throws, and cannot be knocked Prone, but you cannot move. Narcan ends it for free. Recharges on a Short Rest.
Jam a dose of Narcan up your nose and snap your spine back upright with a terrifying pop, ending Fent Lean. Costs nothing.
Scurry frantically across broken glass and hazardous surfaces. As a Bonus Action, Dash and gain +3m movement and immunity to difficult terrain and being knocked Prone until the end of your next turn.

Shake a rusty cup aggressively at every enemy within 6m. Each must make a Wisdom saving throw or become Socially Shamed for 2 turns (Disadvantage on Attack Rolls and they cannot take Reactions). Recharges on a Short Rest.

Unleash an unhinged, ear-splitting 3 AM shriek. Every enemy within 9m takes 6d6 Thunder damage and must make a Wisdom saving throw or become Frightened for 2 turns; on a success, half damage and no fear. Recharges on a Short Rest.

Throw up a tarp-and-shopping-cart bunker. You and every ally within 5m gain 15 Temporary Hit Points, Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing damage for 3 turns, and Sanctuary for 1 turn. Recharges on a Long Rest.

Lob a pressurised five-gallon bucket of aged street slop. Explodes in a 4m radius dealing 6d6 Poison and 3d6 Acid damage (half on a successful Dexterity saving throw), inflicts Fecal Stench on anyone who fails, and leaves a lingering poison cloud. Recharges on a Short Rest.
As a Bonus Action, drive a jagged malt liquor bottleneck into a vital organ. Deals 2d6 + Constitution Piercing and 1d6 Slashing damage and inflicts Bleeding for 2 turns.

Shove a rattling grocery cart packed with scrap metal up to 9m into the enemy ranks, hitting the first creature in your path for 4d8 + Constitution Bludgeoning damage. On a failed Strength saving throw, the target is knocked Prone. Recharges on a Short Rest.
Slip through the fabric of reality like hopping a transit barrier. Teleport up to 18m as a Bonus Action. Once per turn.
Overwhelmed by nauseating biological stench. Disadvantage on Attack Rolls, and takes 1d4 Poison damage at the end of each turn.
Slumped in an unresponsive narcotic daze. Incapacitated: cannot move, act or react. Taking damage does not wake them.
Locked in supreme postural equilibrium. Resistant to all damage, +3 AC, Advantage on Dexterity and Constitution saving throws, immune to Prone, but cannot move.
+3m movement. Immune to difficult terrain and being knocked Prone.
Deeply rattled by persistent street solicitation. Disadvantage on Attack Rolls and cannot take Reactions.
Years of dumpster exposure have forged an impenetrable immune system. Immune to Poisoned and Disease, and Resistant to Poison damage.
While not wearing armour, your Armour Class equals 10 + Dexterity modifier + Constitution modifier. You can still use a shield.
While in Fent Lean, your slowed metabolism knits wounds back together, restoring 2d6 + Constitution Hit Points at the start of each of your turns.
While in Fent Lean, any creature that hits you with a melee attack takes 2d10 Psychic damage from sheer cognitive dissonance.

Petty theft under 950 gold is decriminalised. Whenever you hit an enemy with a melee attack, you snatch a Stolen Patagonia Vest (+1 AC, +1d4 damage on weapon attacks) for 2 turns. Authorities will apologise for profiling you.
Warm, fleece-lined, and acquired without prosecution. +1 Armour Class and +1d4 Bludgeoning damage on weapon attacks.

Rummaging through the coats of foes marinating in your biological weaponry is sustenance. Once per turn, when you damage a creature that has Fecal Stench, you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Constitution modifier + 2 (minimum 3).
Fortified by whatever was in that coat. Grants Temporary Hit Points.

As a Bonus Action, serve a foe with an immediate lease termination. On a failed Wisdom saving throw the target takes 3d6 Psychic damage and suffers Rent Hike for 3 turns: -2 AC, -3m movement, and 2d6 Psychic damage at the start of each of its turns from Bay Area cost of living. Recharges on a Short Rest.
Crushed by runaway housing costs. -2 AC, -3m movement, and takes 2d6 Psychic damage at the start of each turn.
An unbearable 3m miasma radiates from you. Enemies within it reek of Fecal Stench.
Radiating an unbearable 3m stench. Nearby enemies are afflicted with Fecal Stench.
The first time each combat that the municipal cleanup crew drops you below half Hit Points, you reflexively collapse into Fent Lean for 2 turns and gain 20 Temporary Hit Points.
Your survival reflexes need time to reset.

Subject every enemy within 9m to the purgatory of municipal hold music. On a failed Wisdom saving throw, for 3 turns they cannot take Bonus Actions or Reactions and their movement is halved. Costs only a Bonus Action. Recharges on a Short Rest.
Your call is important to us. Please continue to hold. Cannot take Bonus Actions or Reactions, and movement is halved.
Survival on the block keeps you moving. +3m movement and +3 to Initiative.
You have survived things that would kill a dragon. Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing damage, and Advantage on saving throws against being Frightened or Charmed.
Your body found a doorway to curl up in. Grants Temporary Hit Points.
Huddled under a tarp bunker. Temporary Hit Points and Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing damage.
Your poison damage ignores Resistance, and your weapon attacks deal an extra 1d6 Poison damage.
Your body is a walking public-health emergency. Your weapon attacks deal a further 2d6 Poison damage, and you are immune to Poison damage.
Venice gym regulars taught you everything. Your weapon attacks deal an extra 1d8 Bludgeoning damage, and you gain +2 Armour Class.
Nothing on the boardwalk scares you anymore. You score critical hits on a roll of 18-20, and you heal 1d8 Hit Points whenever you hit with a melee attack.
You are never where they expect. +4.5m movement, immunity to difficult terrain, and you learn Express Hop.
No fare, no wait, no action. Teleport up to 9m for free. Once per turn.

Hailing from the Golden State, Californians possess an uncanny resilience shaped by natural disasters, gridlock traffic, and perpetual microclimates. Whether meditating on a Malibu beach or pitching a seed-stage venture in a coffee shop, they navigate Faerûn with effortless chill and passive aggression.
Sun-drenched coastal dwellers who surf metaphysical waves. Radiant resistance, supreme mobility, and the innate ability to 'Hang Ten' across treacherous surfaces.
Disruptive visionaries fortified by microdosed mushroom tea and quarterly pitch decks. Channels psychic energy to disrupt hostile thought patterns and optimize output.
Forged in extreme heatwaves, agricultural dust, and unending highway commutes. Virtually immune to toxic air, burning conditions, and high-temperature environments.
Select your spiritual California identity and pronoun archetype. Each comes with bespoke perks, cultural flair, and cosmic validation.
A timeless, universal California vibration. You greet gods, goblins, and dragons alike as 'dude'. You gain +2 to Persuasion checks and Advantage on saving throws against being Frightened.
You operate in perpetual stealth mode. Treating every battle as a Series-A pitch, you gain +2 to Initiative and Advantage on Deception checks when bluffing.
Completely organic, non-GMO, and free of inflammatory systemic toxins. You are completely immune to the Poisoned condition.
Your chakras are aligned to the exact resonant frequency of Sedona crystals. At the start of combat, you automatically manifest 5 Temporary Hit Points.
You have surrendered all bodily autonomy to predictive machine learning models. You gain a +1 bonus to all Saving Throws as incoming attacks are forecasted in real-time.

Touch a foe and force them to disconnect from online discourse. Deals 1d8 Psychic damage, immediately terminates any active Rage, Frenzy, or Enraged condition, and inflicts Existential Daze (Disadvantage on Attack Rolls for 2 turns).
Nourish yourself with artisanal sourdough topped with mashed Hass avocado and flaky sea salt. Restores 1d6 + CON modifier Hit Points and grants 5 Temporary Hit Points.
Catch the cosmic Pacific swell. Increases movement speed by 3m and grants immunity to difficult terrain and slipping on ice or grease for 2 turns.
Subject a target's consciousness to a brutal seed-stage vibe check. Target must succeed a DC Wisdom saving throw or break concentration and suffer Existential Dread.
Born on the San Andreas Fault, you possess impeccable footing. You cannot be knocked Prone.
Decades spent idling on the I-405 freeway have made you immune to gridlock. You cannot be Slowed or Restrained.
Central Valley dust and Los Angeles smog have turned your respiratory system into an industrial air filter. Advantage on saving throws against being Poisoned, and immune to Disease.
Triple-digit Palm Springs heat is merely room temperature to you. Immune to Burning condition.
Cross-functional synergy allows you to optimize output. Once per turn, dealing weapon damage deals an additional 1d4 Psychic damage.
Disconnected from rage by reality. Suffers Disadvantage on Attack Rolls.
Fortified by artisanal healthy fats. Grants Temporary Hit Points.
Surfing metaphysical waves. +3m Movement Speed and immune to slipping or difficult terrain.
Concentration broken and mind disrupted by venture capital reality.
